 Denver Nuggets 53 – 56 Live Phoenix Suns Live Updated 5 minutes ago Nuggets vs Suns LIVE, Score Updates and Play-by-Play in NBA (53-56)
 Follow Phoenix Suns at Denver Nuggets live from Ball Arena: 2026-27 NBA score updates, Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray vs Devin Booker stats and play-by-play.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 16, 2026, 10:22 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 10:22 PM ET 10:22 PM ET 5 minutes ago Scoring leaders heading into the second half
 For Denver Nuggets , the first-half scoring comes from Nikola Jokic (with 16 points, 9 rebounds and 5 assists), Jamal Murray (with 10 points) and Cameron Johnson (with 8 points), while Phoenix Suns gets its production from Luke Kennard (with 9 points), Collin Gillespie (with 8 points) and Jalen Green (with 7 points).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 10:22 PM ET Scoring leaders heading into the second half 
 10:13 PM ET Halftime at Ball Arena 
 9:34 PM ET End of the first quarter at Ball Arena 
 9:06 PM ET On-court shooting wraps up ahead of delayed… 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 10:18 PM ET 9 minutes ago First-half team stats at Ball Arena
 Through two quarters at Ball Arena, the Phoenix Suns shot 21-for-42 from the field (50%) and hit 7 of 17 from three-point range (41%), adding 27 rebounds and 14 assists. The Denver Nuggets went 21-for-45 overall (47%) but made just 1 of 9 from deep (11%), finishing the opening half with 19 rebounds and 11 assists.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:13 PM ET 13 minutes ago Halftime at Ball Arena
 Devin Booker sank his second free throw just before the second-quarter buzzer at Ball Arena, sending the Phoenix Suns into halftime with a 56-53 advantage over the Denver Nuggets. Nikola Jokic has led Denver through the opening half with 16 points, nine rebounds and five assists, while Luke Kennard tops Phoenix with nine points at the break.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:11 PM ET 16 minutes ago 2Q 32.1 | Action continues between Nuggets and Suns
 Spencer Jones steps to the stripe and hits 1 of 2 from the foul line. Devin Booker converts 1 of 2 from the foul line after drawing the foul. Oso Ighodaro knocks down a jumper off an assist from Devin Booker. Aaron Gordon cashes in 1 of 2 from the foul line.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:07 PM ET 20 minutes ago Oso Ighodaro finishes the trip for Phoenix Suns
 Oso Ighodaro converts a dunk. Play pauses for a timeout with 2:03 showing in the 2nd quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:03 PM ET 24 minutes ago Nuggets pull even behind Jokic and Murray
 Nikola Jokic scored on a layup before fouls on Christian Braun and Jokic sent Oso Ighodaro to the line, where he split two free throws and grabbed the offensive board. A Devin Booker turnover gave Denver possession, and Jamal Murray finished at the rim at Ball Arena. Ighodaro then fouled Jokic, who hit both free throws for the Nuggets.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:59 PM ET 28 minutes ago Bench rotation minutes underway in the 2nd quarter
 Jalen Green converts a three-pointer, set up by Devin Booker. Devin Booker knocks down a jumper. Jamal Murray connects on a layup off an assist from Nikola Jokic. Miles Bridges finishes with a dunk, set up by Oso Ighodaro.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:55 PM ET 32 minutes ago Murray and Braun answer Kennard's three
 After Oso Ighodaro missed two free throws, Jamal Murray drew a Jalen Green foul and sank all three at the line. Miles Bridges then set up Luke Kennard for a Phoenix three-pointer and swatted Bryce Hopkins at the rim. Devin Booker followed with an out-of-bounds turnover, and Murray fed Christian Braun for a mid-range jumper at Ball Arena.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:50 PM ET 36 minutes ago Jokic answers Kennard in the second
 Jamal Murray hit a free throw before Nikola Jokic grabbed an offensive board and scored inside for the Denver Nuggets at Ball Arena. After a Jokic turnover, Dillon Brooks set up Luke Kennard for a mid-range jumper on the Phoenix Suns' next trip. Following defensive rebounds from Oso Ighodaro, Collin Gillespie, and Spencer Jones in the second quarter, Jokic connected on a turnaround jumper.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:47 PM ET 40 minutes ago Gillespie, Kennard spark Suns from beyond the arc
 Marvin Bagley III split two free throws after a Jordan Goodwin foul before Collin Gillespie buried a three-pointer for the Phoenix Suns. Miles Bridges grabbed a defensive rebound and Koa Peat added an offensive board at Ball Arena before Cameron Johnson was whistled for a foul. Gillespie then set up Luke Kennard for another perimeter three-pointer during the second quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:43 PM ET 44 minutes ago Gillespie and Brooks lift Phoenix in second
 Collin Gillespie drained a three-pointer from a Dillon Brooks feed before Cameron Johnson picked Khaman Maluach's pocket for a steal. Gillespie then set up Jordan Goodwin for a layup, and Johnson answered off a DeMar DeRozan pass at Ball Arena. Dillon Brooks added a layup before missing at the free-throw line after a Johnson foul, with Spencer Jones grabbing the rebound.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:39 PM ET an hour ago Bagley answers Maluach with three-point play
 After Cameron Johnson turned the ball over out of bounds, Phoenix capitalized on offensive rebounds from Dillon Brooks and Khaman Maluach as Maluach finished inside early in the second quarter. Denver answered right back at Ball Arena when Marvin Bagley III slammed home a dunk off a Tyus Jones feed, drew a foul on Maluach and sank his free throw to complete the three-point play.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:34 PM ET an hour ago End of the first quarter at Ball Arena
 Jordan Goodwin grabbed an offensive board to give the Phoenix Suns another late look, but Marvin Bagley III controlled the defensive glass to end the sequence. The horn then sounded at Ball Arena to wrap up the first quarter with the Denver Nuggets holding a four-point lead over Phoenix.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:33 PM ET an hour ago Jokic, Brazile power Denver late in the first
 Nikola Jokic got Denver on the board late in the first quarter with a two-point basket before Collin Gillespie answered for Phoenix off a Devin Booker feed. Tyus Jones then grabbed an offensive rebound for the Suns at Ball Arena. At the other end, Trevon Brazile pulled down his own offensive board and threw down a dunk for the Nuggets.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:29 PM ET an hour ago Jokic, Murray spark Denver late in the first
 Oso Ighodaro split two free throws before Jamal Murray dunked off a Nikola Jokic feed and Jokic scored from Spencer Jones. Trevon Brazile added a second-chance basket for Denver, while Devin Booker found Ryan Dunn for a dunk and Jordan Goodwin for a layup. Nikola Jokic tacked on another field goal before a Ryan Dunn turnover returned possession to the Nuggets in the opening quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:25 PM ET an hour ago Ighodaro and Goodwin spark Phoenix in the first
 Oso Ighodaro blocked Nikola Jokic at the rim and fed Jalen Green for a dunk before Aaron Gordon answered off a Jamal Murray pass. Devin Booker then pulled down an offensive board to set up Jordan Goodwin's three-pointer for Phoenix. Christian Braun added a dunk from Nikola Jokic after a steal on Jalen Green, though Braun was whistled for a foul.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:20 PM ET an hour ago Cameron Johnson sparks Denver in the first
 Cameron Johnson opened the stretch with a pull-up jumper before a Jamal Murray foul sent Jalen Green to the line for a pair of free throws. Following turnovers by Miles Bridges and Green, Johnson finished two straight layups off assists from Nikola Jokic and Christian Braun. Play pauses for a first-quarter timeout at Ball Arena with 7:05 on the clock.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:15 PM ET an hour ago Paint touches creating looks in the 1st quarter
 Miles Bridges knocks down a two-point basket. Christian Braun connects on a layup, set up by Nikola Jokic. Dillon Brooks finishes with a dunk on the pass from Devin Booker. Miles Bridges scores on a tip-in.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:12 PM ET an hour ago Tip-off at Ball Arena between Nuggets and Suns
 We are underway at Ball Arena for the opening quarter between the Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns. Denver starts Nikola Jokic, Aaron Gordon, Cameron Johnson, Jamal Murray and Christian Braun, while Phoenix counters with Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges, Oso Ighodaro, Devin Booker and Jalen Green. Dillon Brooks commits an early turnover at 11:26 to give possession back to the Nuggets.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:06 PM ET an hour ago On-court shooting wraps up ahead of delayed tip-off: Denver Nuggets vs Phoenix Suns
 Broadcast coverage on Suns Live has reached courtside at Ball Arena (Denver) as Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns wrap up final shooting reps past the top of the hour. Statistical leaders entering tonight: Jamal Murray (Denver Nuggets, 25.9 Points) and Devin Booker (Phoenix Suns, 24.8 Points) .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:59 PM ET an hour ago Player introductions and national anthem in Denver
 Starting-lineup introductions and the national anthem are underway at Ball Arena (Denver) during the live Suns Live broadcast ahead of tip-off between Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns (records: Denver Nuggets 7-4 , Phoenix Suns 5-7 ).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:52 PM ET 2 hours ago Teams back out at Ball Arena ahead of tip-off
 Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns take the court at Ball Arena (Denver) (records: Denver Nuggets 7-4 , Phoenix Suns 5-7 ) ahead of tip-off on Suns Live . Assigned officials: Nick Buchert, Dedric Taylor and Suyash Mehta .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:44 PM ET 2 hours ago Nuggets and Suns head to the locker rooms
 With 15 minutes until tip-off at Ball Arena in Denver, the Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns have headed back to their locker rooms ahead of tonight's arena walkout. Tonight's NBA officiating crew at Ball Arena features Nick Buchert, Dedric Taylor and Suyash Mehta as Denver and Phoenix complete their pregame locker room preparations.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:36 PM ET 2 hours ago Murray and Booker take the court in Denver
 With 20 minutes remaining until tip-off at Ball Arena, the Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns are on the floor for shooting and position drills. The 7-4 Nuggets enter with Jamal Murray averaging 25.9 points per game, while Devin Booker tops the 5-7 Suns at 24.8 points per game.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:30 PM ET 2 hours ago Countdown to tip-off at Ball Arena
 The clock is down to 30 minutes before tip-off between the 7-4 Denver Nuggets and the 5-7 Phoenix Suns at Ball Arena in Denver. Broadcast coverage of the NBA matchup airs on Suns Live as Denver brings a 7-4 record onto its home floor against a 5-7 Phoenix side.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:26 PM ET 2 hours ago Final court check ahead of Nuggets vs Suns
 Players are on site at Ball Arena as Denver Nuggets and Phoenix Suns get ready for action in NBA .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:09 PM ET 2 hours ago Starting lineups coming up from Ball Arena
 Tip-off is 30 minutes away at 5,280 feet as Devin Booker, Miles Bridges and the 5-7 Phoenix Suns visit Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray and the 7-4 Denver Nuggets at 10:00 p.m. ET (8:00 p.m. MT). Official starting fives and opening-tip action follow next on VAVEL USA.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:47 PM ET 3 hours ago 7-3 over their last 10: Denver climbing the Northwest ladder
 David Adelman's Nuggets have won seven of their past 10 games, sitting just 1.5 games behind division-leading Portland entering Monday night's late tip.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:26 PM ET 3 hours ago Khaman Maluach and Oso Ighodaro carry center duties without Mark Williams
 With Mark Williams ruled out, 7-foot rookie Khaman Maluach and agile forward Oso Ighodaro split interior minutes against Jokic on the Ball Arena glass.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:05 PM ET 3 hours ago Cameron Johnson and DeMar DeRozan stretch Phoenix's wing defense
 Surrounding Nikola Jokic (9.1 APG) and Jamal Murray (25.9 PPG) with veteran scorers DeMar DeRozan and former Suns forward Cameron Johnson punishes any double-team sent into the post.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:43 PM ET 4 hours ago Phoenix chasing its first away win of 2026-27 (0-3 road)
 All five of Phoenix's wins this season have come at home (5-4 home, 0-3 road), raising the stakes as Devin Booker and Miles Bridges open a quick road trip in Denver.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:22 PM ET 4 hours ago 247 total points in October's 127-120 Nuggets win at Phoenix
 When these teams met 16 days ago on Oct. 31, Denver shot past Phoenix 127-120 on the road, clearing tonight's 227.5-point DraftKings total by nearly 20 points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Nuggets vs Suns: Peacock, Arizona's Family 3TV and tip-off time
 Phoenix Suns (5-7) at Denver Nuggets (7-4) tips off at 10:00 p.m. ET / 8:00 p.m. MT / 7:00 p.m. PT (03:00 UTC Tuesday) tonight, Monday, Nov. 16, inside Ball Arena in Denver, Colorado.
 Fans can stream nationally across the United States on Peacock , watch free over-the-air and online across Arizona via Arizona's Family 3TV and Suns Live , or tune in locally across the Rocky Mountain region on Altitude Sports.
 Unopposed late-night Western Conference hoops close out Monday's NBA slate.
 Stay courtside with VAVEL USA for official starting lineups 30 minutes prior to tip, quarter-by-quarter scoring splits for Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, DeMar DeRozan, Devin Booker and Miles Bridges, and live play-by-play through the final buzzer.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Heavy double-digit spread for Denver at Ball Arena
 Oddsmakers factor Phoenix's 0-3 road record, Mark Williams's absence at center and mile-high back-to-back travel heavily into Monday's line.
 DraftKings installs Denver as a 10.5-point home favorite (DEN -10.5, moneyline -438; Phoenix +10.5, moneyline +341) with an over/under total set at 227.5 points after their Oct. 31 meeting in Arizona produced 247 combined points (127-120). ESPN's Matchup Predictor gives the Nuggets a 70.6 percent win probability compared to 29.4 percent for the Suns.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Northwest and Pacific Division standings check entering Nov. 16
 Western Conference playoff positioning is already tightening across both divisions two and a half weeks into the schedule:
 Northwest Division: 1. Portland Trail Blazers (9-3, .750, W3), 2. Minnesota Timberwolves (9-4, .692, 0.5 GB), 3. Oklahoma City Thunder (9-5, .643, 1.0 GB), 4. Denver Nuggets (7-4, .636, 1.5 GB, W2, 2-2 home, 5-4 West) and 5. Utah Jazz (1-13, .071, 9.0 GB).
 Pacific Division: 1. LA Lakers (12-2, .857, W8), 2. Golden State Warriors (8-5, .615, 3.5 GB), 3. Phoenix Suns (5-7, .417, 6.0 GB, 0-3 road, 3-7 West), 4. LA Clippers (4-8, .333, 7.0 GB) and 5. Sacramento Kings (1-12, .077, 10.5 GB).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Elite ball movement on both sides: 27.7 APG vs 27.2 APG
 Few NBA matchups feature cleaner half-court passing numbers than tonight's pairing.
 Denver averages 27.7 assists against 13.4 turnovers per game while shooting 49 percent from the floor (35 percent from three-point range) and collecting 9.0 steals alongside 4.5 blocks a night. Phoenix nearly matches that playmaking volume at 27.2 assists against 13.9 turnovers per outing, shooting 47 percent on field goals and a slightly sharper 37 percent clip from beyond the arc alongside 8.4 steals and 4.5 blocks.
 Perimeter point-of-attack defense becomes the swing factor: Christian Braun and Aaron Gordon take turns crowding Devin Booker (25.5 PPG) and Jalen Green off ball screens, while Dillon Brooks and 6-foot-8 stopper Ryan Dunn draw Jamal Murray (25.9 PPG) and DeMar DeRozan in the mid-range.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Mile-high back-to-back test for both locker rooms at 5,280 feet
 Zero rest days separate Sunday's games from tonight's 8:00 p.m. Mountain tip-off.
 Both rosters played yesterday on Nov. 15: Denver flew home overnight from Louisiana after beating the Pelicans 116-108, while Phoenix hopped north from the desert following its 131-123 track meet against Los Angeles. Playing the second leg of a back-to-back at 5,280 feet above sea level inside 19,520-seat Ball Arena historically taxes visiting rotations in the 3rd and 4th quarters, putting heavy pressure on Jordan Ott's second unit of Luke Kennard, Collin Gillespie, Jordan Goodwin, Rasheer Fleming and rookie forward Koa Peat against a Suns defense allowing 117.3 points per game.
 Denver's bench counters with Tyus Jones, Cam Whitmore, DaRon Holmes II, Marvin Bagley III, Ryan Nembhard and Zeke Nnaji to keep fresh legs around Nikola Jokic.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Injury report: Mark Williams and Julian Strawther ruled out
 Center depth remains Phoenix's toughest hurdle against Nikola Jokic inside Ball Arena.
 Phoenix rules out starting 7-footer Mark Williams once again, while reserve forward Drew Timme carries a day-to-day tag. Without Williams anchoring the paint, Jordan Ott leans on playmaking forward Oso Ighodaro , rookie 7-foot shot-blocker Khaman Maluach and stretch big Duop Reath to contend with Jokic (10.5 RPG), Aaron Gordon and Marvin Bagley III on the boards, where Denver holds a 42.3 to 38.9 rebounding edge per game.
 Denver lists only reserve wing Julian Strawther as out on Monday's injury report, leaving David Adelman with full perimeter depth across Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, DeMar DeRozan, Cameron Johnson, Tyus Jones, Cam Whitmore, Spencer Jones, Alpha Diallo, Bryce Hopkins and Trevon Brazile.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Devin Booker's 25.5 PPG carries Phoenix onto the road after 131-123 loss to Lakers
 Phoenix leaves Arizona for the first time in over two weeks tonight.
 Jordan Ott's club just wrapped up a five-game homestand at 3-2, edging Houston 102-99 on Nov. 8, losing 122-96 to San Antonio on Nov. 10, blowing out the LA Clippers 133-110 on Nov. 11, beating Charlotte 101-96 on Nov. 13 and dropping yesterday afternoon's 131-123 shootout against the Pacific-leading Lakers on Nov. 15. Franchise guard Devin Booker tops Phoenix at 25.5 points and 5.0 assists per game.
 Flanking Booker are ironman forward Miles Bridges (team-high 7.3 rebounds per game), physical wing Dillon Brooks , explosive scorer Jalen Green and perimeter defender Ryan Dunn , while Luke Kennard and Collin Gillespie space the floor off the bench.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Denver already took Game 1 in Phoenix 127-120 on Halloween night
 Familiarity runs deep between these two Western Conference foes.
 Sixteen nights ago on Oct. 31, Denver walked into Phoenix and claimed a 127-120 road victory to take a 1-0 lead in their four-game regular-season series. Since then, the Nuggets have gone 4-1 across their last five contests: routing Toronto 128-109 on Nov. 5, beating Indiana 114-102 on Nov. 7, falling 110-100 at Houston on Nov. 10, outlasting Memphis 123-118 on Nov. 12 and winning 116-108 at New Orleans last night on Nov. 15.
 Following tonight's clash at Ball Arena, the series pauses until Jan. 6, 2027 back in Denver before concluding April 2 in Phoenix.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago 25.9 PPG for Jamal Murray alongside Nikola Jokic's 10.5 RPG and 9.1 APG
 Denver's two-man engine is humming through 11 regular-season outings.
 Point guard Jamal Murray leads the Nuggets in scoring at 25.9 points per game, punishing drop coverages with pull-up jumpers and curling off handoffs from three-time MVP Nikola Jokic , who paces Denver in both rebounding (10.5 boards per night) and playmaking (9.1 assists per game). Together they power an offense averaging 114.6 points on 49 percent field-goal accuracy and 27.7 assists against just 13.4 total turnovers.
 Around Jokic and Murray, David Adelman rolls out a veteran-heavy wing rotation featuring mid-range master DeMar DeRozan , athletic finisher Aaron Gordon , 6-foot-8 sniper Cameron Johnson and downhill guard Christian Braun , with floor general Tyus Jones, Cam Whitmore, Marvin Bagley III and DaRon Holmes II leading the second unit.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Late-night West marquee in Denver: Nikola Jokic and Nuggets host Devin Booker's Suns
 Good evening from Mile High Denver and welcome to VAVEL USA's live courtside coverage of the Phoenix Suns at Denver Nuggets in Monday's unopposed late-window Western Conference feature. Opening tip-off inside Ball Arena is scheduled for 10:00 p.m. ET (8:00 p.m. local MT, 7:00 p.m. PT) across Peacock, Altitude, Suns Live and Arizona's Family 3TV.
 Round 2 of a four-game regular-season rivalry.
 David Adelman's Nuggets enter at 7-4 (.636, winners of seven of their last 10) after sweeping consecutive road games in Memphis and New Orleans. Jordan Ott's Suns arrive at 5-7 (.417, 0-3 away from Phoenix), chasing their first road victory of the 2026-27 NBA campaign.
 Official starting lineups drop 30 minutes prior to tip-off, followed by quarter-by-quarter box score stats and live play-by-play.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
